header.title: Where to buy
header.text: If you'd like to buy PrimaSTEM for yourself, order it from our distributors below. And if there are none in your country yet, ask any local supplier to get in touch with us.

directOrder: You can also order directly from us, but the price will be higher than through our distributors. We'll hand your order over to your courier service at our warehouse in France.
